texts.lev.8.23: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood thereof, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
texts.lev.8.24: And he brought Aaron's sons; and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
texts.lev.8.25: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh:
texts.lev.8.26: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Jehovah, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and upon the right thigh:
texts.lev.8.27: and he put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and waved them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
texts.lev.8.28: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt-offering: they were a consecration for a sweet savor: it was an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.8.29: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: it was Moses' portion of the ram of consecration; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
texts.lev.8.30: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
texts.lev.8.31: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tent of meeting: and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
texts.lev.8.32: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
texts.lev.8.33: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration be fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
texts.lev.8.34: As hath been done this day, so Jehovah hath commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
texts.lev.8.35: And at the door of the tent of meeting shall ye abide day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
texts.lev.8.36: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which Jehovah commanded by Moses.
texts.lev.9.1: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
texts.lev.9.2: and he said unto Aaron, Take thee a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering, without blemish, and offer them before Jehovah.
texts.lev.9.3: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a he-goat for a sin-offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt-offering;
texts.lev.9.4: and an ox and a ram for peace-offerings, to sacrifice before Jehovah; and a meal-offering mingled with oil: for to-day Jehovah appeareth unto you.
texts.lev.9.5: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tent of meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Jehovah.
texts.lev.9.6: And Moses said, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded that ye should do: and the glory of Jehovah shall appear unto you.
texts.lev.9.7: And Moses said unto Aaron, Draw near unto the altar, and offer thy sin-offering, and thy burnt-offering, and make atonement for thyself, and for the people; and offer the oblation of the people, and make atonement for them; as Jehovah commanded.
texts.lev.9.8: So Aaron drew near unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin-offering, which was for himself.
texts.lev.9.9: And the sons of Aaron presented the blood unto him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:
texts.lev.9.10: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul from the liver of the sin-offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
texts.lev.9.11: And the flesh and the skin he burnt with fire without the camp.
texts.lev.9.12: And he slew the burnt-offering; and Aaron's sons delivered unto him the blood, and he sprinkled it upon the altar round about.
texts.lev.9.13: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
texts.lev.9.14: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt-offering on the altar.
texts.lev.9.15: And he presented the people's oblation, and took the goat of the sin-offering which was for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
texts.lev.9.16: And he presented the burnt-offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
texts.lev.9.17: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.
texts.lev.9.18: He slew also the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons delivered unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
texts.lev.9.19: and the fat of the ox and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covereth [the inwards], and the kidneys, and the caul of the liver:
texts.lev.9.20: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
texts.lev.9.21: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave-offering before Jehovah; as Moses commanded.
texts.lev.9.22: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings.
texts.lev.9.23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the people.
texts.lev.9.24: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and consumed upon the altar the burnt-offering and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
texts.lev.10.1: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took each of them his censer, and put fire therein, and laid incense thereon, and offered strange fire before Jehovah, which he had not commanded them.
texts.lev.10.2: And there came forth fire from before Jehovah, and devoured them, and they died before Jehovah.
texts.lev.10.3: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that Jehovah spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
texts.lev.10.4: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Draw near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
texts.lev.10.5: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
texts.lev.10.6: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Let not the hair of your heads go loose, neither rend your clothes; that ye die not, and that he be not wroth with all the congregation: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Jehovah hath kindled.
texts.lev.10.7: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tent of meeting, lest ye die; for the anointing oil of Jehovah is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
texts.lev.10.8: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.10.9: Drink no wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tent of meeting, that ye die not: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
texts.lev.10.10: and that ye may make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;
texts.lev.10.11: and that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Jehovah hath spoken unto them by Moses.
texts.lev.10.12: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meal-offering that remaineth of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar; for it is most holy;
texts.lev.10.13: and ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy portion, and thy sons' portion, of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: for so I am commanded.
texts.lev.10.14: And the wave-breast and the heave-thigh shall ye eat in a clean place, thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they are given as thy portion, and thy sons' portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.
texts.lev.10.15: The heave-thigh and the wave-breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave-offering before Jehovah: and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, as a portion for ever; as Jehovah hath commanded.
texts.lev.10.16: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin-offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron that were left, saying,
texts.lev.10.17: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin-offering in the place of the sanctuary, seeing it is most holy, and he hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Jehovah?
texts.lev.10.18: Behold, the blood of it was not brought into the sanctuary within: ye should certainly have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.
texts.lev.10.19: And Aaron spake unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin-offering and their burnt-offering before Jehovah; and there have befallen me such things as these: and if I had eaten the sin-offering to-day, would it have been well-pleasing in the sight of Jehovah?
texts.lev.10.20: And when Moses heard [that], it was well-pleasing in his sight.
texts.lev.11.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
texts.lev.11.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the living things which ye may eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
texts.lev.11.3: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.
texts.lev.11.4: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that part the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.5: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, he is unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.6: And the hare, because she cheweth the cud but parteth not the hoof, she is unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.7: And the swine, because he parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.8: Of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch; they are unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.9: These may ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that may ye eat.
texts.lev.11.10: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination unto you,
texts.lev.11.11: and they shall be an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, and their carcasses ye shall have in abomination.
texts.lev.11.12: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that is an abomination unto you.
texts.lev.11.13: And these ye shall have in abomination among the birds; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the gier-eagle, and the ospray,
texts.lev.11.14: and the kite, and the falcon after its kind,
texts.lev.11.16: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the seamew, and the hawk after its kind,
texts.lev.11.17: and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
texts.lev.11.18: and the horned owl, and the pelican, and the vulture,
texts.lev.11.19: and the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
texts.lev.11.20: All winged creeping things that go upon all fours are an abomination unto you.
texts.lev.11.21: Yet these may ye eat of all winged creeping things that go upon all fours, which have legs above their feet, wherewith to leap upon the earth.
texts.lev.11.22: Even these of them ye may eat: the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the cricket after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.
texts.lev.11.23: But all winged creeping things, which have four feet, are an abomination unto you.
texts.lev.11.24: And by these ye shall become unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcass of them shall be unclean until the even;
texts.lev.11.25: And whosoever beareth [aught] of the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.26: Every beast which parteth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, is unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
texts.lev.11.27: And whatsoever goeth upon its paws, among all beasts that go on all fours, they are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcass shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.28: And he that beareth the carcass of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.29: And these are they which are unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the great lizard after its kind,
texts.lev.11.30: and the gecko, and the land-crocodile, and the lizard, and the sand-lizard, and the chameleon.
texts.lev.11.31: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.32: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherewith any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.
texts.lev.11.33: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean, and it ye shall break.
texts.lev.11.34: All food [therein] which may be eaten, that on which water cometh, shall be unclean; and all drink that may be drunk in every [such] vessel shall be unclean.
texts.lev.11.35: And every thing whereupon [any part] of their carcass falleth shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.36: Nevertheless a fountain or a pit wherein is a gathering of water shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcass shall be unclean.
texts.lev.11.37: And if [aught] of their carcass fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
texts.lev.11.38: But if water be put upon the seed, and [aught] of their carcass fall thereon, it is unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.39: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcass thereof shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.40: And he that eateth of the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcass of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.41: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
texts.lev.11.42: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all fours, or whatsoever hath many feet, even all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
texts.lev.11.43: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
texts.lev.11.44: For I am Jehovah your God: sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that moveth upon the earth.
texts.lev.11.45: For I am Jehovah that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
texts.lev.11.46: This is the law of the beast, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth;
texts.lev.11.47: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.
texts.lev.12.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.12.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a man-child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity of her sickness shall she be unclean.
texts.lev.12.3: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
texts.lev.12.4: And she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
texts.lev.12.5: But if she bear a maid-child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her impurity; and she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying threescore and six days.
texts.lev.12.6: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtle-dove, for a sin-offering, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest:
texts.lev.12.7: and he shall offer it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her that beareth, whether a male or a female.
texts.lev.12.8: And if her means suffice not for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
texts.lev.13.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.13.2: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
texts.lev.13.3: and the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and if the hair in the plague be turned white, and the appearance of the plague be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
texts.lev.13.4: And if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague seven days:
texts.lev.13.5: and the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if in his eyes the plague be at a stay, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
texts.lev.13.6: and the priest shall look on him again the seventh day; and, behold, if the plague be dim, and the plague be not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
texts.lev.13.7: But if the scab spread abroad in the skin, after that he hath showed himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again:
texts.lev.13.8: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the scab be spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.
texts.lev.13.9: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
texts.lev.13.10: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if there be a white rising in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising,
texts.lev.13.11: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: he shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.
texts.lev.13.12: And if the leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the plague from his head even to his feet, as far as appeareth to the priest;
texts.lev.13.13: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
texts.lev.13.14: But whensoever raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
texts.lev.13.15: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean: it is leprosy.
texts.lev.13.16: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, then he shall come unto the priest;
texts.lev.13.17: and the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the plague be turned into white, then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: he is clean.
texts.lev.13.18: And when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a boil, and it is healed,
texts.lev.13.19: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then is shall be showed to the priest;
texts.lev.13.20: and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy, it hath broken out in the boil.
texts.lev.13.21: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and it be not lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
texts.lev.13.22: And if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
texts.lev.13.23: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
texts.lev.13.24: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick [flesh] of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;
texts.lev.13.25: then the priest shall look upon it; and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin; it is leprosy, it hath broken out in the burning: and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
texts.lev.13.26: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
texts.lev.13.27: and the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
texts.lev.13.28: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim; it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is the scar of the burning.
texts.lev.13.29: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,
texts.lev.13.30: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
texts.lev.13.31: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague of the scall seven days:
texts.lev.13.32: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,
texts.lev.13.33: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days more:
texts.lev.13.34: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
texts.lev.13.35: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
texts.lev.13.36: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
texts.lev.13.37: But if in his eyes the scall be at a stay, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
texts.lev.13.38: And when a man or a woman hath in the skin of the flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
texts.lev.13.39: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin; he is clean.
texts.lev.13.40: And if a man's hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; [yet] is he clean.
texts.lev.13.41: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald; [yet] is he clean.
texts.lev.13.42: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
texts.lev.13.43: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh;
texts.lev.13.44: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is in his head.
texts.lev.13.45: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
texts.lev.13.46: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.
texts.lev.13.47: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
texts.lev.13.48: whether it be in warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;
texts.lev.13.49: if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be showed unto the priest.
texts.lev.13.50: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up [that which hath] the plague seven days:
texts.lev.13.51: and he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
texts.lev.13.52: And he shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in woollen or in linen, or anything of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
texts.lev.13.53: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
texts.lev.13.54: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
texts.lev.13.55: and the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its color, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire: it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.
texts.lev.13.56: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
texts.lev.13.57: and if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is breaking out: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
texts.lev.13.58: And the garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
texts.lev.13.59: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
texts.lev.14.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.14.2: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest:
texts.lev.14.3: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look; and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper,
texts.lev.14.4: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
texts.lev.14.5: And the priest shall command to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
texts.lev.14.6: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
texts.lev.14.7: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let go the living bird into the open field.
texts.lev.14.8: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
texts.lev.14.9: And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
texts.lev.14.10: And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one ewe-lamb a year old without blemish, and three tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
texts.lev.14.11: And the priest that cleanseth him shall set the man that is to be cleansed, and those things, before Jehovah, at the door of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.14.12: And the priest shall take one of the he-lambs, and offer him for a trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah:
texts.lev.14.13: and he shall kill the he-lamb in the place where they kill the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the place of the sanctuary: for as the sin-offering is the priest's, so is the trespass-offering: it is most holy:
texts.lev.14.14: and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
texts.lev.14.15: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand;
texts.lev.14.16: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah:
texts.lev.14.17: and of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass-offering:
texts.lev.14.18: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.19: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness: and afterward he shall kill the burnt-offering;
texts.lev.14.20: and the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the meal-offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
texts.lev.14.21: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much, then he shall take one he-lamb for a trespass-offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth part [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering, and a log of oil;
texts.lev.14.22: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.14.23: And on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah:
texts.lev.14.24: and the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.25: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
texts.lev.14.26: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;
texts.lev.14.27: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Jehovah:
texts.lev.14.28: and the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering:
texts.lev.14.29: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.30: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to get,
texts.lev.14.31: even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, with the meal-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.32: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to get [that which pertaineth] to his cleansing.
texts.lev.14.33: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.14.34: When ye are come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
texts.lev.14.35: then he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, There seemeth to me to be as it were a plague in the house.
texts.lev.14.36: And the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goeth in to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
texts.lev.14.37: and he shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and the appearance thereof be lower than the wall;
texts.lev.14.38: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
texts.lev.14.39: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
texts.lev.14.40: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which the plague is, and cast them into an unclean place without the city:
texts.lev.14.41: and he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scrape off, without the city into an unclean place:
texts.lev.14.42: and they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
texts.lev.14.43: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken out the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;
texts.lev.14.44: then the priest shall come in and look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
texts.lev.14.45: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
texts.lev.14.46: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.14.47: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
texts.lev.14.48: And if the priest shall come in, and look, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered; then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
texts.lev.14.49: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
texts.lev.14.50: and he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
texts.lev.14.51: and he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
texts.lev.14.52: and he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
texts.lev.14.53: but he shall let got the living bird out of the city into the open field: so shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.
texts.lev.14.54: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and for a scall,
texts.lev.14.55: and for the leprosy of a garment, and for a house,
texts.lev.14.56: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;
texts.lev.14.57: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
texts.lev.15.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.15.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
texts.lev.15.3: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
texts.lev.15.4: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and everything whereon he sitteth shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.5: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.6: And he that sitteth on anything whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.7: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.8: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.9: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.10: And whosoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.11: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.12: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
texts.lev.15.13: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
texts.lev.15.14: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest:
texts.lev.15.15: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his issue.
texts.lev.15.16: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.17: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.18: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.19: And if a woman have an issue, [and] her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.20: And everything that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean: everything also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.21: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.22: And whosoever toucheth anything that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.23: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.24: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.25: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.
texts.lev.15.26: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity: and everything whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
texts.lev.15.27: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.28: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
texts.lev.15.29: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.15.30: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the issue of her uncleanness.
texts.lev.15.31: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in the midst of them.
texts.lev.15.32: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;
texts.lev.15.33: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
texts.lev.16.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Jehovah, and died;
texts.lev.16.2: and Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.
texts.lev.16.3: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.16.4: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
texts.lev.16.5: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.16.6: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
texts.lev.16.7: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.16.8: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.
texts.lev.16.9: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer him for a sin-offering.
texts.lev.16.10: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement for him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.
texts.lev.16.11: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself:
texts.lev.16.12: and he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:
texts.lev.16.13: and he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
texts.lev.16.14: and he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy-seat on the east; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
texts.lev.16.15: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat:
texts.lev.16.16: and he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins: and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
texts.lev.16.17: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
texts.lev.16.18: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
texts.lev.16.19: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
texts.lev.16.20: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat:
texts.lev.16.21: and Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a man that is in readiness into the wilderness:
texts.lev.16.22: and the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a solitary land: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
texts.lev.16.23: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
texts.lev.16.24: and he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
texts.lev.16.25: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.
texts.lev.16.26: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
texts.lev.16.27: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
texts.lev.16.28: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
texts.lev.16.29: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you:
texts.lev.16.30: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.
texts.lev.16.31: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
texts.lev.16.32: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments:
texts.lev.16.33: and he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
texts.lev.16.34: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
texts.lev.17.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.17.2: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
texts.lev.17.3: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
texts.lev.17.4: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
texts.lev.17.5: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.17.6: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.17.7: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute forever unto them throughout their generations.
texts.lev.17.8: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,
texts.lev.17.9: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.
texts.lev.17.10: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
texts.lev.17.11: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.
texts.lev.17.12: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
texts.lev.17.13: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
texts.lev.17.14: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is [all one] with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
texts.lev.17.15: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
texts.lev.17.16: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.
texts.lev.18.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.18.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.18.3: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.
texts.lev.18.4: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.18.5: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.6: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.7: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.8: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
texts.lev.18.9: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
texts.lev.18.10: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
texts.lev.18.11: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.12: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
texts.lev.18.13: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
texts.lev.18.14: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
texts.lev.18.15: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.16: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
texts.lev.18.17: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
texts.lev.18.18: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival [to her], to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.
texts.lev.18.19: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
texts.lev.18.20: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor's wife, to defile thyself with her.
texts.lev.18.21: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through [the fire] to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.22: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
texts.lev.18.23: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
texts.lev.18.24: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;
texts.lev.18.25: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.
texts.lev.18.26: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you;
texts.lev.18.27: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);
texts.lev.18.28: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
texts.lev.18.29: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
texts.lev.18.30: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.19.2: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.
texts.lev.19.3: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.4: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.5: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.
texts.lev.19.6: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.
texts.lev.19.7: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:
texts.lev.19.8: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
texts.lev.19.9: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.
texts.lev.19.10: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.11: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.
texts.lev.19.12: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.13: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
texts.lev.19.14: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.15: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.
texts.lev.19.16: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.17: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
texts.lev.19.18: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.19: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.
texts.lev.19.20: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
texts.lev.19.21: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.
texts.lev.19.22: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.
texts.lev.19.23: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.
texts.lev.19.24: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.25: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.26: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.
texts.lev.19.27: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
texts.lev.19.28: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.29: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
texts.lev.19.30: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.31: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.32: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.33: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.
texts.lev.19.34: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.35: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
texts.lev.19.36: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
texts.lev.19.37: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.20.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.20.2: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
texts.lev.20.3: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
texts.lev.20.4: And if the people at the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;
texts.lev.20.5: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.
texts.lev.20.6: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
texts.lev.20.7: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.20.8: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.
texts.lev.20.9: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
texts.lev.20.10: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
texts.lev.20.11: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
texts.lev.20.12: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
texts.lev.20.13: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
texts.lev.20.14: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
texts.lev.20.15: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
texts.lev.20.16: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
texts.lev.20.17: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
texts.lev.20.18: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
texts.lev.20.19: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
texts.lev.20.20: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
texts.lev.20.21: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
texts.lev.20.22: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.
texts.lev.20.23: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
texts.lev.20.24: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.
texts.lev.20.25: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.
texts.lev.20.26: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.
texts.lev.20.27: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.
texts.lev.21.1: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;
texts.lev.21.2: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
texts.lev.21.3: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.
texts.lev.21.4: He shall not defile himself, [being] a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
texts.lev.21.5: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
texts.lev.21.6: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
texts.lev.21.7: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
texts.lev.21.8: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.
texts.lev.21.9: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
texts.lev.21.10: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;
texts.lev.21.11: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
texts.lev.21.12: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.21.13: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
texts.lev.21.14: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.
texts.lev.21.15: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.
texts.lev.21.16: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.21.17: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
texts.lev.21.18: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,
texts.lev.21.19: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
texts.lev.21.20: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
texts.lev.21.21: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
texts.lev.21.22: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:
texts.lev.21.23: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
texts.lev.21.24: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
texts.lev.22.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.2: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.3: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.4: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
texts.lev.22.5: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
texts.lev.22.6: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.
texts.lev.22.7: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
texts.lev.22.8: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.9: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
texts.lev.22.10: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest's, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
texts.lev.22.11: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
texts.lev.22.12: And if a priest's daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.
texts.lev.22.13: But if a priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
texts.lev.22.14: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.
texts.lev.22.15: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,
texts.lev.22.16: and [so] cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
texts.lev.22.17: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.18: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;
texts.lev.22.19: that ye may be accepted, [ye shall offer] a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.
texts.lev.22.20: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
texts.lev.22.21: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
texts.lev.22.22: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.23: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
texts.lev.22.24: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do [thus] in your land.
texts.lev.22.25: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
texts.lev.22.26: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.27: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.28: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
texts.lev.22.29: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.
texts.lev.22.30: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.31: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.32: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,
texts.lev.22.33: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.1: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
texts.lev.23.3: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.
texts.lev.23.4: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.
texts.lev.23.5: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah's passover.
texts.lev.23.6: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.
texts.lev.23.7: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.
texts.lev.23.8: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
texts.lev.23.9: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.10: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:
texts.lev.23.11: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
texts.lev.23.12: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.13: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts [of an ephah] of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
texts.lev.23.14: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
texts.lev.23.15: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:
texts.lev.23.16: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.17: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts [of an ephah]: they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.18: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.19: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.
texts.lev.23.20: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.
texts.lev.23.21: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
texts.lev.23.22: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.23.23: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.24: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
texts.lev.23.25: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.26: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.27: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.28: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.
