texts.lev.11.14: and the falcon, and the kite, after its kind;
texts.lev.11.16: and the female ostrich and the male ostrich, and the sea-gull, and the hawk, after its kind;
texts.lev.11.17: and the owl, and the gannet, and the ibis,
texts.lev.11.18: and the swan, and the pelican, and the carrion vulture,
texts.lev.11.19: and the stork; the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
texts.lev.11.20: Every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four shall be an abomination unto you.
texts.lev.11.21: Yet these shall ye eat of every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four: those which have legs above their feet with which to leap upon the earth.
texts.lev.11.22: These shall ye eat of them: the arbeh after its kind, and the solam after its kind, and the hargol after its kind, and the hargab after its kind.
texts.lev.11.23: But every winged crawling thing that hath four feet shall be an abomination unto you.
texts.lev.11.24: And by these ye shall make yourselves unclean; whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.25: And whoever carrieth [ought] of their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.26: Every beast that hath cloven hoofs, but not feet quite split open, nor cheweth the cud, shall be unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
texts.lev.11.27: And whatever goeth on its paws, among all manner of beasts that go upon all four, those are unclean unto you: whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.28: And he that carrieth their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: they shall be unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.29: And these shall be unclean unto you among the crawling things which crawl on the earth: the mole, and the field-mouse, and the lizard, after its kind;
texts.lev.11.30: and the groaning lizard, and the great red lizard, and the climbing lizard, and the chomet, and the chameleon.
texts.lev.11.31: These shall be unclean unto you among all that crawl: whoever toucheth them when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.32: And on whatever any of them when they are dead doth fall, it shall be unclean; all vessels of wood, or garment, or skin, or sack, every vessel wherewith work is done -- it shall be put into water, and be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.
texts.lev.11.33: And every earthen vessel into which [any] of them falleth -- whatever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
texts.lev.11.34: All food that is eaten on which [such] water hath come shall be unclean; and all drink that is drunk shall be unclean, in every [such] vessel.
texts.lev.11.35: And everything where upon [any part] of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; oven and hearth shall be broken down: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.36: Nevertheless, a spring or a well, a quantity of water, shall be clean. But he that toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
texts.lev.11.37: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing-seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean;
texts.lev.11.38: but if water have been put on the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
texts.lev.11.39: And if any beast which is to you for food die, he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.40: And he that eateth of its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: he also that carrieth its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.11.41: And every crawling thing which crawleth on the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
texts.lev.11.42: Whatever goeth on the belly, and whatever goeth on all four, and all that have a great many feet, of every manner of crawling thing which crawleth on the earth -- these ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
texts.lev.11.43: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable through any crawling thing which crawleth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
texts.lev.11.44: For I am Jehovah your God; and ye shall hallow yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy; and ye shall not make yourselves unclean through any manner of crawling thing which creepeth on the earth.
texts.lev.11.45: For I am Jehovah who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
texts.lev.11.46: This is the law of cattle, and of fowl, and of every living soul that moveth in the waters, and of every soul that crawleth on the earth;
texts.lev.11.47: to make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that is to be eaten and the beast that is not to be eaten.
texts.lev.12.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.12.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a male, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the separation of her infirmity shall she be unclean.
texts.lev.12.3: And on the eighth day shall the flesh of his foreskin be circumcised.
texts.lev.12.4: And she shall continue thirty-three days in the blood of her cleansing; no holy thing shall she touch, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her cleansing are fulfilled.
texts.lev.12.5: And if she bear a female, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation; and she shall continue sixty-six days in the blood of her cleansing.
texts.lev.12.6: And when the days of her cleansing are fulfilled, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a yearling lamb for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon or a turtle-dove for a sin-offering, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, unto the priest.
texts.lev.12.7: And he shall present it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be clean from the flux of her blood. This is the law for her that hath borne a male or a female.
texts.lev.12.8: And if her hand cannot find what is sufficient for a sheep, she shall bring two turtle-doves or two young pigeons; one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her; and she shall be clean.
texts.lev.13.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.13.2: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising or a scab, or bright spot, and it become in the skin of his flesh a sore [as] of leprosy, then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests.
texts.lev.13.3: And when the priest looketh on the sore in the skin of the flesh, and the hair in the sore is turned white, and the sore looketh deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is the sore of leprosy; and the priest shall look on him and pronounce him unclean.
texts.lev.13.4: But if the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and look not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white, the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the sore seven days.
texts.lev.13.5: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day; and behold, in his sight, the sore remaineth as it was, the sore hath not spread in the skin, then the priest shall shut him up seven days a second time.
texts.lev.13.6: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day, and behold, the sore is become pale and the sore hath not spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is a scab; and he shall wash his garments and be clean.
texts.lev.13.7: But if the scab have spread much in the skin, after that he hath been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again;
texts.lev.13.8: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the scab hath spread in the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is leprosy.
texts.lev.13.9: When a sore [as] of leprosy is in a man, he shall be brought unto the priest;
texts.lev.13.10: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, there is a white rising in the skin, and it hath turned the hair white, and a trace of raw flesh is in the rising:
texts.lev.13.11: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and he shall not shut him up, for he is unclean.
texts.lev.13.12: But if the leprosy break out much in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the sore, from his head even to his foot, wherever the eyes of the priest look,
texts.lev.13.13: and the priest looketh, and behold, the leprosy covereth all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the sore; it is all turned white; he is clean.
texts.lev.13.14: And on the day when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
texts.lev.13.15: And the priest shall look on the raw flesh, and shall pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean, it is leprosy.
texts.lev.13.16: But if the raw flesh change again, and be turned white, he shall come unto the priest;
texts.lev.13.17: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the sore is turned white; then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the sore: he is clean.
texts.lev.13.18: And the flesh -- when in the skin thereof cometh a boil, and it is healed,
texts.lev.13.19: and there is in the place of the boil a white rising, or a white-reddish bright spot, it shall be shewn to the priest;
texts.lev.13.20: and the priest shall look on it, and behold, it looketh deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof is turned white; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy broken out in the boil.
texts.lev.13.21: But if the priest look on it, and behold, there are no white hairs therein, and it is not deeper than the skin, and is pale, the priest shall shut him up seven days;
texts.lev.13.22: and if it spread much in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore.
texts.lev.13.23: But if the bright spot have remained in its place, [and] have not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
texts.lev.13.24: Or if in the flesh, in the skin thereof, there is a burning inflammation, and the place of the inflammation become a bright spot white-reddish or white,
texts.lev.13.25: and the priest look on it, and behold, the hair is turned white in the bright spot, and it looketh deeper than the skin, it is a leprosy which is broken out in the inflammation; and the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy.
texts.lev.13.26: But if the priest look on it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is no deeper than the skin, and is pale, the priest shall shut him up seven days.
texts.lev.13.27: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day, and if it have spread much in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the sore of leprosy.
texts.lev.13.28: But if the bright spot have remained in its place, [and] not spread in the skin, and is pale, it is the rising of the inflammation; and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar of the inflammation.
texts.lev.13.29: And if a man or a woman have a sore on the head or on the beard,
texts.lev.13.30: and the priest look on the sore, and behold, it looketh deeper than the skin, and there is in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a scall, the leprosy of the head or the beard.
texts.lev.13.31: And if the priest look on the sore of the scall, and behold, it is not in sight deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the sore of the scall seven days.
texts.lev.13.32: And when the priest looketh on the sore on the seventh day, and behold, the scall hath not spread, and there is in it no yellow hair, and the scall doth not look deeper than the skin,
texts.lev.13.33: he [that hath the sore] shall shave himself; but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days a second time.
texts.lev.13.34: And the priest shall look on the scall on the seventh day, and behold, the scall hath not spread in the skin, nor is in sight deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his garments, and be clean.
texts.lev.13.35: But if the scall have spread much in the skin after his cleansing,
texts.lev.13.36: and the priest shall look on him, and behold, the scall hath spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair: he is unclean.
texts.lev.13.37: But if the scall have in his sight remained as it was, and there is black hair grown up therein, the scall is healed: he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
texts.lev.13.38: And if a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, white bright spots,
texts.lev.13.39: and the priest look, and behold, there are in the skin of their flesh pale white spots, it is an eruption which is broken out in the skin: he is clean.
texts.lev.13.40: And if a man's hair have fallen off his head, he is bald: he is clean;
texts.lev.13.41: and if he have the hair fallen off from the part of the head towards his face, he is forehead-bald: he is clean.
texts.lev.13.42: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white-reddish sore, it is a leprosy which hath broken out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
texts.lev.13.43: And the priest shall look on it, and behold, the rising of the sore is white-reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of the leprosy in the skin of the flesh;
texts.lev.13.44: he is a leprous man, he is unclean; the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his sore is in his head.
texts.lev.13.45: And as to the leper in whom the sore is, -- his garments shall be rent, and his head shall be uncovered, and he shall put a covering on his beard, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean!
texts.lev.13.46: All the days that the sore shall be in him he shall be unclean: he is unclean; he shall dwell apart; outside the camp shall his dwelling be.
texts.lev.13.47: And if a sore of leprosy is in a garment, in a woollen garment, or a linen garment,
texts.lev.13.48: either in the warp or in the woof of linen or of wool, or in a skin, or in anything made of skin,
texts.lev.13.49: and the sore is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is the sore of leprosy, and shall be shewn unto the priest.
texts.lev.13.50: And the priest shall look on the sore, and shall shut up [that which hath] the sore seven days.
texts.lev.13.51: And he shall see the sore on the seventh day: if the sore have spread in the garment, either in the warp or in the woof, or in a skin, in any work that may be made of skin, the sore is a corroding leprosy: it is unclean.
texts.lev.13.52: And they shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, of wool or of linen, or anything of skin, wherein the sore is; for it is a corroding leprosy: it shall be burned with fire.
texts.lev.13.53: But if the priest look, and behold, the sore hath not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin,
texts.lev.13.54: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the sore is, and he shall shut it up seven days a second time.
texts.lev.13.55: And the priest shall look on the sore after the washing, and behold, if the sore have not changed its appearance, and the sore have not spread, it is unclean: thou shalt burn it with fire: it is a fretting sore on what is threadbare or where the nap is gone.
texts.lev.13.56: But if the priest look, and behold, the sore hath become pale after the washing of it, then he shall rend it from the garment, or from the skin, or from the warp, or from the woof.
texts.lev.13.57: And if it appear still in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is a [leprosy] breaking out: thou shalt burn with fire that wherein the sore is.
texts.lev.13.58: But the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin which thou hast washed, and the sore departeth from them, it shall be washed a second time, and it is clean.
texts.lev.13.59: This is the law of the sore of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, to cleanse it, or to pronounce it unclean.
texts.lev.14.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.14.2: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest,
texts.lev.14.3: and the priest shall go out of the camp; and when the priest looketh, and behold, the sore of leprosy is healed in the leper,
texts.lev.14.4: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two clean living birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.
texts.lev.14.5: And the priest shall command that one bird be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
texts.lev.14.6: as to the living bird -- he shall take it, and the cedar-wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water;
texts.lev.14.7: and he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
texts.lev.14.8: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his garments, and shave all his hair, and bathe in water, and he shall be clean; and afterwards shall he come into the camp, and shall abide outside his tent seven days.
texts.lev.14.9: And it shall come to pass on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair, his head, and his beard, and his eyebrows, even all his hair shall he shave, and he shall wash his garments, and shall bathe his flesh in water, and he is clean.
texts.lev.14.10: And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one yearling ewe-lamb without blemish, and three tenth parts of fine flour mingled with oil, for an oblation, and one log of oil.
texts.lev.14.11: And the priest that cleanseth [him] shall present the man that is to be cleansed and those things before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.14.12: And the priest shall take one he-lamb, and present it for a trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.13: And he shall slaughter the he-lamb at the place where the sin-offering and the burnt-offering are slaughtered, in a holy place; for as the sin-offering, so the trespass-offering is the priest's: it is most holy.
texts.lev.14.14: And the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
texts.lev.14.15: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into his, the priest's, left hand;
texts.lev.14.16: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.17: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put on the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass-offering.
texts.lev.14.18: And the remainder of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.19: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterwards shall he slaughter the burnt-offering.
texts.lev.14.20: And the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the oblation upon the altar; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
texts.lev.14.21: But if he be poor, and his hand be not able to get it, then he shall take one lamb for a trespass-offering, for a wave-offering, to make atonement for him; and one tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for an oblation; and a log of oil,
texts.lev.14.22: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, as his hand may be able to get: the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.14.23: And he shall bring them on the eighth day of his cleansing unto the priest, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.24: And the priest shall take the he-lamb of the trespass-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave-offering before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.25: And he shall slaughter the he-lamb of the trespass-offering; and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
texts.lev.14.26: And the priest shall pour of the oil into [his], the priest's, left hand,
texts.lev.14.27: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.28: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering.
texts.lev.14.29: And the remainder of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.30: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, of what his hand was able to get;
texts.lev.14.31: of what his hand was able to get shall the one be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering, with the oblation; and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.
texts.lev.14.32: This is the law for him in whom is the sore of leprosy, whose hand cannot get what is [regularly prescribed] in his cleansing.
texts.lev.14.33: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.14.34: When ye come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a leprous plague in a house of the land of your possession,
texts.lev.14.35: then he whose house it is shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me like a plague in the house;
texts.lev.14.36: and the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean; and afterwards the priest shall go in to see the house.
texts.lev.14.37: And when he looketh on the plague, and behold, the plague is in the walls of the house, greenish or reddish hollows, and their look is deeper than the surface of the wall,
texts.lev.14.38: then the priest shall go out of the house to the entrance of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
texts.lev.14.39: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and when he looketh, and behold, the plague hath spread in the walls of the house,
texts.lev.14.40: then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them out of the city, in an unclean place.
texts.lev.14.41: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar that they have scraped off, out of the city in an unclean place.
texts.lev.14.42: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and they shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
texts.lev.14.43: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered,
texts.lev.14.44: then the priest shall come, and when he looketh, and behold, the plague hath spread in the house, it is a corroding leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
texts.lev.14.45: And they shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house, and shall carry them forth out of the city to an unclean place.
texts.lev.14.46: And he that goeth into the house as long as it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.14.47: And he that sleepeth in the house shall wash his garments, and he that eateth in the house shall wash his garments.
texts.lev.14.48: But if the priest shall come in and look, and behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house hath been plastered, the priest shall pronounce the house clean; for the plague is healed.
texts.lev.14.49: And he shall take, to purge the house from the defilement, two birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop;
texts.lev.14.50: and he shall kill one bird in an earthen vessel over running water;
texts.lev.14.51: and he shall take the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times;
texts.lev.14.52: and he shall purge the house from the defilement with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar-wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;
texts.lev.14.53: and he shall let the living bird loose out of the city into the open field; and he shall make atonement for the house, and it is clean.
texts.lev.14.54: This is the law for every sore of leprosy, and for the scall,
texts.lev.14.55: and for the leprosy of garments, and of houses,
texts.lev.14.56: and for the rising, and for the scab, and for the bright spot,
texts.lev.14.57: to teach when there is uncleanness, and when it is purified: this is the law of leprosy.
texts.lev.15.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.lev.15.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man have a flux from his flesh, because of his flux he is unclean.
texts.lev.15.3: And this shall be his uncleanness in his flux: whether his flesh run with his flux, or his flesh be closed from his flux, it is his uncleanness.
texts.lev.15.4: Every bed whereon he lieth that hath the flux shall be unclean; and every object on which he sitteth shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.5: And whoever toucheth his bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.6: And he that sitteth on any object whereon he sat that hath the flux shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.7: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the flux shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.8: And if he that hath the flux spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.9: And what carriage soever he rideth upon that hath the flux shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.10: And whoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even; and he that carrieth them shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.11: And whomsoever he toucheth who hath the flux and hath not rinsed his hands in water -- he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.12: And the vessel of earth that he toucheth who hath the flux shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
texts.lev.15.13: And when he that hath a flux is clean of his flux, then he shall count seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and he shall be clean.
texts.lev.15.14: And on the eighth day he shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest.
texts.lev.15.15: And the priest shall offer them, one as a sin-offering, and one as a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his flux.
texts.lev.15.16: And if any man's seed of copulation pass from him, then he shall bathe his whole flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.17: And every garment, and every skin, whereon the seed of copulation shall be, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.18: And a woman with whom a man lieth with seed of copulation -- they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.19: And if a woman have a flux, and her flux in her flesh be blood, she shall be seven days in her separation, and whoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.20: And everything that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean; and everything that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.21: And whoever toucheth her bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.22: And whoever toucheth any object that she sat upon shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.23: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.24: And if a man lie with her at all, and the uncleanness of her separation come upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
texts.lev.15.25: And if a woman have her flux of blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if she have the flux beyond the time of her separation, all the days of the flux of her uncleanness shall she be as [in] the days of her separation: she is unclean.
texts.lev.15.26: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her flux shall be unto her as the bed of her separation; and every object on which she sitteth shall be unclean, according to the uncleanness of her separation.
texts.lev.15.27: And whoever toucheth them shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
texts.lev.15.28: And if she be cleansed of her flux then she shall count seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
texts.lev.15.29: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.15.30: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin-offering, and the other as a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the flux of her uncleanness.
texts.lev.15.31: And ye shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.
texts.lev.15.32: This is the law for him that hath a flux, and for the one whose seed of copulation goeth from him, and who is defiled therewith:
texts.lev.15.33: and for a woman who is sick in her separation, and for him that hath his flux; for the man and for the woman, and for him that lieth with her that is unclean.
texts.lev.16.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Jehovah and died;
texts.lev.16.2: and Jehovah said to Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the sanctuary inside the veil before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark, that he die not; for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.
texts.lev.16.3: In this manner shall Aaron come into the sanctuary: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.16.4: A holy linen vest shall he put on, and linen trousers shall be upon his flesh, and he shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
texts.lev.16.5: And of the assembly of the children of Israel shall he take two bucks of the goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
texts.lev.16.6: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
texts.lev.16.7: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah, before the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.lev.16.8: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats: one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.
texts.lev.16.9: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer it [as] a sin-offering.
texts.lev.16.10: And the goat upon which the lot fell for Azazel shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement with it, to send it away as Azazel into the wilderness.
texts.lev.16.11: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall slaughter the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself.
texts.lev.16.12: And he shall take the censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and both his hands full of fragrant incense beaten small, and bring it inside the veil.
texts.lev.16.13: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat which is upon the testimony, that he die not.
texts.lev.16.14: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle with his finger upon the front of the mercy-seat eastward; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood seven times with his finger.
texts.lev.16.15: And he shall slaughter the goat of the sin-offering, which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat;
texts.lev.16.16: and he shall make atonement for the sanctuary, [to cleanse it] from the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and from their transgressions in all their sins; and so shall he do for the tent of meeting which dwelleth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
texts.lev.16.17: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the sanctuary until he come out; and he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and for the whole congregation of Israel.
texts.lev.16.18: And he shall go out unto the altar which is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about;
texts.lev.16.19: and he shall sprinkle upon it of the blood with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
texts.lev.16.20: And when he hath ended making atonement for the sanctuary, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the living goat;
texts.lev.16.21: and Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the living goat, and confess over it all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away to the wilderness by the hand of a man standing ready;
texts.lev.16.22: that the goat may bear upon him all their iniquities to a land apart [from men]; and he shall send away the goat into the wilderness.
texts.lev.16.23: And Aaron shall go into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the sanctuary, and shall leave them there;
texts.lev.16.24: and he shall bathe his flesh with water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and go forth, and offer his burnt-offering, and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself, and for the people.
texts.lev.16.25: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.
texts.lev.16.26: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water; and afterwards he may come into the camp.
texts.lev.16.27: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the sanctuary, shall one carry forth outside the camp; and they shall burn with fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
texts.lev.16.28: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water; and afterwards he may come into the camp.
texts.lev.16.29: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you. In the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, the home-born, and the stranger that sojourneth among you;
texts.lev.16.30: for on that day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you: from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.
texts.lev.16.31: A sabbath of rest shall it be unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls: [it is] an everlasting statute.
texts.lev.16.32: And the priest who hath been anointed, and who hath been consecrated, to exercise the priesthood in his father's stead, shall make atonement; and he shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments.
texts.lev.16.33: And he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and for the tent of meeting, and for the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests, and for the whole people of the congregation shall he make atonement.
texts.lev.16.34: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel [to cleanse them] from all their sins once a year. And he did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.lev.17.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.17.2: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
texts.lev.17.3: Every one of the house of Israel that slaughtereth an ox, or sheep, or goat, in the camp, or that slaughtereth it out of the camp,
texts.lev.17.4: and doth not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah, before the tabernacle of Jehovah, blood shall be reckoned unto that man: he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people,
texts.lev.17.5: to the end that the children of Israel bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they bring them to Jehovah, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace-offerings to Jehovah.
texts.lev.17.6: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet odour to Jehovah.
texts.lev.17.7: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto demons, after whom they go a whoring. This shall be an everlasting statute unto them for their generations.
texts.lev.17.8: And thou shalt say unto them, Every one of the house of Israel, and of the strangers who sojourn among them, that offereth up a burnt-offering or sacrifice,
texts.lev.17.9: and bringeth it not to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to offer it up to Jehovah -- that man shall be cut off from his peoples.
texts.lev.17.10: And every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, -- I will set my face against the soul that hath eaten blood, and will cut him off from among his people;
texts.lev.17.11: for the soul of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls, for it is the blood that maketh atonement for the soul.
texts.lev.17.12: Therefore have I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall the stranger who sojourneth among you eat blood.
texts.lev.17.13: And every one of the children of Israel, and of the strangers who sojourn among them, that catcheth in the hunt a beast or fowl that may be eaten, he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with earth;
texts.lev.17.14: for as to the life of all flesh, its blood is the life in it; and I have said unto the children of Israel, Of the blood of no manner of flesh shall ye eat, for the life of all flesh is its blood: whoever eateth it shall be cut off.
texts.lev.17.15: And every soul that eateth of a dead carcase, or of that which was torn, be it one home-born, or a stranger, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even: then he shall be clean.
texts.lev.17.16: And if he wash them not nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.
texts.lev.18.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.18.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.18.3: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do; and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their customs.
texts.lev.18.4: Mine ordinances shall ye do and my statutes shall ye observe to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.18.5: And ye shall observe my statutes and my judgments, by which the man that doeth them shall live: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.6: No one shall approach to any that is his near relation, to uncover his nakedness: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.7: The nakedness of thy father, and the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother: thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.8: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
texts.lev.18.9: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, born at home, or born abroad -- their nakedness shalt thou not uncover.
texts.lev.18.10: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter -- their nakedness shalt thou not uncover; for theirs is thy nakedness.
texts.lev.18.11: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father: she is thy sister: thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.12: The nakedness of thy father's sister shalt thou not uncover: she is thy father's near relation.
texts.lev.18.13: The nakedness of thy mother's sister shalt thou not uncover; for she is thy mother's near relation.
texts.lev.18.14: The nakedness of thy father's brother shalt thou not uncover; thou shalt not approach his wife: she is thine aunt.
texts.lev.18.15: The nakedness of thy daughter-in-law shalt thou not uncover: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.16: The nakedness of thy brother's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy brother's nakedness.
texts.lev.18.17: The nakedness of a woman and her daughter shalt thou not uncover; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, nor her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness: they are her near relations: it is wickedness.
texts.lev.18.18: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness beside her, during her life.
texts.lev.18.19: And thou shalt not approach a woman in the separation of her uncleanness to uncover her nakedness.
texts.lev.18.20: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to become unclean with her.
texts.lev.18.21: And thou shalt not give of thy seed to let them pass through [the fire] to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.18.22: And thou shalt not lie with mankind as one lieth with a woman: it is an abomination.
texts.lev.18.23: And thou shalt lie with no beast to become unclean therewith; and a woman shall not stand before a beast to lie down with it: it is confusion.
texts.lev.18.24: Make not yourselves unclean in any of these things; for in all these have the nations which I am casting out before you made themselves unclean.
texts.lev.18.25: And the land hath become unclean; and I visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out its inhabitants.
texts.lev.18.26: But *ye* shall observe my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of all these abominations: the home-born, and the stranger that sojourneth among you;
texts.lev.18.27: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, who were before you, and the land hath been made unclean);
texts.lev.18.28: that the land vomit you not out, when ye make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
texts.lev.18.29: For whoever committeth any of these abominations, ... the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
texts.lev.18.30: And ye shall observe my charge, that ye commit not [any] of the abominable customs which were committed before you; and ye shall not make yourselves unclean therein: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.19.2: Speak unto all the assembly of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Holy shall ye be, for I Jehovah your God am holy.
texts.lev.19.3: Ye shall reverence every man his mother, and his father, and my sabbaths shall ye keep: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.4: Ye shall not turn unto idols, and ye shall not make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.5: And if ye sacrifice a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.
texts.lev.19.6: On the day when ye sacrifice it shall it be eaten, and on the morrow; and that which remaineth until the third day shall be burned with fire.
texts.lev.19.7: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an unclean thing: it shall not be accepted.
texts.lev.19.8: And he that eateth it shall bear his iniquity; for he hath profaned the hallowed thing of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his peoples.
texts.lev.19.9: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, and the gleaning of thy harvest thou shalt not gather.
texts.lev.19.10: And thy vineyard shalt thou not glean, neither shalt thou gather what hath been left of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and the stranger: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.11: Ye shall not steal, and ye shall not deal falsely, and ye shall not lie one to another.
texts.lev.19.12: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.13: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbour, neither rob him. The wages of the hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
texts.lev.19.14: Thou shalt not revile a deaf person, and thou shalt not put a stumbling-block before a blind one; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.15: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment; thou shalt not respect the person of the lowly, nor honour the person of the great; in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
texts.lev.19.16: Thou shalt not go about as a talebearer among thy people; thou shalt not stand up against the life of thy neighbour: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.17: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart; thou shalt earnestly rebuke thy neighbour, lest thou bear sin on account of him.
texts.lev.19.18: Thou shalt not avenge thyself, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.19: My statutes shall ye observe. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with another sort; thou shalt not sow thy field with seed of two sorts; and a garment woven of two materials shall not come upon thee.
texts.lev.19.20: And if a man lie with a woman for copulation, and she is a bondwoman betrothed to a husband, but not at all ransomed, nor hath freedom been given to her, there shall be a chastisement: they shall not be put to death, for she was not free.
texts.lev.19.21: And he shall bring his trespass-offering to Jehovah, unto the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram for a trespass-offering.
texts.lev.19.22: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath done; and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
texts.lev.19.23: And when ye come into the land and plant all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count its fruit as uncircumcised, three years shall it be uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of;
texts.lev.19.24: and in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy for praise to Jehovah;
texts.lev.19.25: and in the fifth year shall ye eat the fruit thereof, that it may increase unto you the produce thereof: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.26: Ye shall eat nothing with the blood. -- Ye shall not practise enchantment, nor use auguries.
texts.lev.19.27: -- Ye shall not shave the corners of your head round, neither shalt thou mutilate the corners of thy beard.
texts.lev.19.28: And cuttings for a dead person shall ye not make in your flesh, nor put any tattoo writing upon you: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.29: -- Do not profane thy daughter, to give her up to whoredom; lest the land practise whoredom, and the land become full of infamy.
texts.lev.19.30: -- My sabbaths shall ye keep, and my sanctuary shall ye reverence: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.31: -- Turn not unto necromancers and unto soothsayers; seek not after them to make yourselves unclean: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.32: Before the hoary head thou shalt rise up, and shalt honour the face of an old man; and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.19.33: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not molest him.
texts.lev.19.34: As one born among you shall the stranger who sojourneth with you be unto you; and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.19.35: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measure of length, in weight, and in measure of capacity:
texts.lev.19.36: just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
texts.lev.19.37: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.20.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.20.2: Thou shalt say also to the children of Israel, Every one of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech, shall certainly be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
texts.lev.20.3: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, so as to make my sanctuary unclean, and to profane my holy name.
texts.lev.20.4: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, that they kill him not,
texts.lev.20.5: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
texts.lev.20.6: -- And the soul that turneth unto necromancers and unto soothsayers, to go a whoring after them, I will set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
texts.lev.20.7: Hallow yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.20.8: And ye shall observe my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who hallow you.
texts.lev.20.9: Whatever man revileth his father and his mother shall certainly be put to death: he hath reviled his father and his mother; his blood is upon him.
texts.lev.20.10: And a man that committeth adultery with a man's wife, who committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, -- the adulterer and the adulteress shall certainly be put to death.
texts.lev.20.11: And a man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.
texts.lev.20.12: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall certainly be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood is upon them.
texts.lev.20.13: And if a man lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.
texts.lev.20.14: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is infamy: they shall burn him and them with fire, that there be no infamy among you.
texts.lev.20.15: And if a man lie with a beast for copulation, he shall certainly be put to death; and ye shall kill the beast.
texts.lev.20.16: And if a woman approach unto any beast to gender therewith, thou shalt kill the woman and the beast: they shall certainly be put to death; their blood is upon them.
texts.lev.20.17: And if a man take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness, that is a disgrace; and they shall be cut off before the eyes of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
texts.lev.20.18: And if a man shall lie with a woman in her infirmity, and uncover her nakedness, her flux doth he lay bare, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood; and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
texts.lev.20.19: And the nakedness of thy mother's sister, and of thy father's sister shalt thou not uncover; for he hath laid naked his near relation: they shall bear their iniquity.
texts.lev.20.20: And if a man lie with his aunt, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: their sin shall they bear: they shall die childless.
texts.lev.20.21: And if a man take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness: they shall be childless.
texts.lev.20.22: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them, that the land whither I bring you to dwell therein vomit you not out.
texts.lev.20.23: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for all these things have they done, and they became an abomination to me.
texts.lev.20.24: And I have said unto you, Ye shall possess their land, and I will give it unto you for a possession; a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who have separated you from the peoples.
texts.lev.20.25: And ye shall make a separation between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean, and ye shall not make yourselves an abomination by beast, or by fowl, or by anything that creepeth on the ground which I have separated for you, declaring [it] as unclean.
texts.lev.20.26: And ye shall be holy unto me; for I Jehovah am holy, and have separated you from the peoples to be mine.
texts.lev.20.27: And if there be a man or a woman in whom is a spirit of Python or of divination, they shall certainly be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood is upon them.
texts.lev.21.1: And Jehovah said to Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none make himself unclean for a dead person among his peoples,
texts.lev.21.2: except for his immediate relation, who is near unto him -- for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother;
texts.lev.21.3: and for his sister, a virgin, that is near unto him, who hath had no husband, for her may he make himself unclean.
texts.lev.21.4: He shall not make himself unclean [who is] a chief among his peoples, to profane himself.
texts.lev.21.5: They shall not make any baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
texts.lev.21.6: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they present Jehovah's offerings by fire, the bread of their God; therefore shall they be holy.
texts.lev.21.7: They shall not take as wife a whore, or a dishonoured woman; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband; for he is holy unto his God.
texts.lev.21.8: And thou shalt hallow him; for the bread of thy God doth he present: he shall be holy unto thee; for I, Jehovah, who hallow you am holy.
texts.lev.21.9: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burned with fire.
texts.lev.21.10: And the high priest among his brethren, on whose head the anointing oil was poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his garments.
texts.lev.21.11: Neither shall he come near any person dead, nor make himself unclean for his father and for his mother;
texts.lev.21.12: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.21.13: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
texts.lev.21.14: A widow, or a divorced woman, or a dishonoured one, a harlot, these shall he not take; but he shall take as wife a virgin from among his peoples.
texts.lev.21.15: And he shall not profane his seed among his peoples; for I am Jehovah who do hallow him.
texts.lev.21.16: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.21.17: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Any of thy seed throughout their generations that hath any defect, shall not approach to present the bread of his God;
texts.lev.21.18: for whatever man hath a defect, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or one limb longer than the other,
texts.lev.21.19: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
texts.lev.21.20: or hump-backed, or withered, or that hath a spot in his eye, or hath the itch, or scabs, or his testicles broken.
texts.lev.21.21: No man of the seed of Aaron the priest that hath defect shall come near to present Jehovah's offerings by fire: he hath a defect; he shall not come near to present the bread of his God.
texts.lev.21.22: The bread of his God, of the most holy and of the holy, shall he eat;
texts.lev.21.23: only he shall not come in unto the veil, nor shall he draw near unto the altar; for he hath a defect: that he profane not my sanctuaries; for I am Jehovah who do hallow them.
texts.lev.21.24: And Moses told it to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
texts.lev.22.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.2: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in the things that they hallow unto me: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.3: Say unto them, Every one of all your seed, throughout your generations, that approacheth the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.4: Whatsoever man of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a flux, he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. And he that toucheth any one that is unclean by a dead person, or a man whose seed of copulation hath passed from him;
texts.lev.22.5: or a man that toucheth any crawling thing whereby he becometh unclean, or a man by whom he may become unclean, whatever may be his uncleanness,
texts.lev.22.6: -- a person that toucheth any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things; but he shall bathe his flesh with water,
texts.lev.22.7: and when the sun goeth down, he shall be clean, and may afterwards eat of the holy things; for it is his food.
texts.lev.22.8: Of a dead carcase and what is torn shall he not eat, to make himself unclean therewith: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.9: And they shall keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die by it, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who do hallow them.
texts.lev.22.10: And no stranger shall eat the holy thing; the sojourner with the priest, and the hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
texts.lev.22.11: But if a priest buy any one for money, he may eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they may eat of his food.
texts.lev.22.12: And a priest's daughter who is [married] to a stranger may not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.
texts.lev.22.13: But a priest's daughter that becometh a widow, or is divorced, and hath no seed, and returneth unto her father's house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food; but no stranger shall eat thereof.
texts.lev.22.14: And if a man eat of a holy thing through inadvertence, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
texts.lev.22.15: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel which they offer unto Jehovah,
texts.lev.22.16: and cause them to bear the iniquity of trespass when they eat their holy things; for I am Jehovah who do hallow them.
texts.lev.22.17: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.18: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that presenteth his offering for any of his vows, and for any of his voluntary offerings, which they present to Jehovah as a burnt-offering,
texts.lev.22.19: it shall be for your acceptance, without blemish, a male of the oxen, of the sheep, and of the goats.
texts.lev.22.20: Nothing that hath a defect shall ye present; for it shall not be acceptable for you.
texts.lev.22.21: And if any present a sacrifice of peace-offering to Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or a voluntary offering of oxen or small cattle, it shall be without blemish to be accepted: there shall be no defect therein.
texts.lev.22.22: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or ulcerous, or with itch, or scabbed -- ye shall not present these to Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.23: A bullock and a sheep that hath a member too long or too short, that mayest thou offer as a voluntary offering; but as a vow it shall not be accepted.
texts.lev.22.24: That which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut shall ye not present to Jehovah; neither in your land shall ye do [the like].
texts.lev.22.25: Nor from the hand of the stranger shall ye present the bread of your God, of any of these; for their corruption is in them: a defect is in them; they shall not be accepted for you.
texts.lev.22.26: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.22.27: An ox, or a sheep, or a goat, when it is brought forth, shall be seven days under its dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.28: A cow, or sheep -- it and its young shall ye not slaughter in one day.
texts.lev.22.29: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.
texts.lev.22.30: On that day shall it be eaten: ye shall leave none of it until morning: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.31: And ye shall observe my commandments and do them: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.22.32: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who do hallow you,
texts.lev.22.33: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, [Concerning] the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim as holy convocations -- these are my set feasts.
texts.lev.23.3: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation; no manner of work shall ye do: it is the sabbath to Jehovah in all your dwellings.
texts.lev.23.4: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons:
texts.lev.23.5: In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, between the two evenings, is the passover to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.6: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of unleavened bread to Jehovah; seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread.
texts.lev.23.7: On the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.lev.23.8: And ye shall present to Jehovah an offering by fire seven days; on the seventh day is a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.lev.23.9: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.10: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When ye come into the land that I give unto you, and ye reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest.
texts.lev.23.11: And he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you; on the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
texts.lev.23.12: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf, a he-lamb without blemish, a yearling, for a burnt-offering to Jehovah;
texts.lev.23.13: and the oblation thereof: two tenths of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering by fire to Jehovah for a sweet odour; and the drink-offering thereof, of wine, a fourth part of a hin.
texts.lev.23.14: And ye shall not eat bread, or roast corn, or green ears, until the same day that ye have brought the offering of your God: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
texts.lev.23.15: And ye shall count from the morning after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering, seven weeks; they shall be complete;
texts.lev.23.16: even unto the morning after the seventh sabbath shall ye count fifty days; and ye shall present a new oblation to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.17: Out of your dwellings shall ye bring two wave-loaves, of two tenths of fine flour; with leaven shall they be baken; [as] first-fruits to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.18: And ye shall present with the bread seven he-lambs without blemish, yearlings, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering to Jehovah with their oblation, and their drink-offerings, an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.19: And ye shall sacrifice one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs, yearlings, for a sacrifice of peace-offering.
texts.lev.23.20: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits as a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two he-lambs; they shall be holy to Jehovah, for the priest.
texts.lev.23.21: And ye shall make proclamation on that same day -- a holy convocation shall it be unto you: no manner of servile work shall ye do: [it is] an everlasting statute in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
texts.lev.23.22: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not in thy harvest entirely reap the corners of thy field, and the gleaning of thy harvest shalt thou not gather: thou shalt leave them unto the poor and to the stranger: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.23.23: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.24: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first of the month, shall ye have a rest, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
texts.lev.23.25: No manner of servile work shall ye do; and ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.26: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.27: Also on the tenth of this seventh month is the day of the atonement: a holy convocation shall it be unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and present an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.28: And ye shall do no manner of work on that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.23.29: For every soul that is not afflicted on that same day, shall be cut off from among his peoples.
texts.lev.23.30: And every soul that doeth any manner of work on that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
texts.lev.23.31: No manner of work shall ye do: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
texts.lev.23.32: A sabbath of rest shall it be unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls. On the ninth of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
texts.lev.23.33: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.23.34: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths seven days to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.35: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.lev.23.36: Seven days ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah; on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.lev.23.37: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present an offering by fire to Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and an oblation, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, everything upon its day;
texts.lev.23.38: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your voluntary offerings, which ye give to Jehovah.
texts.lev.23.39: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the produce of the land, ye shall celebrate the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.
texts.lev.23.40: And ye shall take on the first day the fruit of beautiful trees, palm branches and the boughs of leafy trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.
texts.lev.23.41: And ye shall celebrate it as a feast to Jehovah seven days in the year: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations; in the seventh month shall ye celebrate it.
texts.lev.23.42: In booths shall ye dwell seven days; all born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
texts.lev.23.43: that your generations may know that I caused the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.23.44: And Moses declared the set feasts of Jehovah to the children of Israel.
texts.lev.24.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.24.2: Command the children of Israel that they bring unto thee pure beaten olive oil for the light, to light the lamp continually.
texts.lev.24.3: Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron dress it from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: [it is] an everlasting statute throughout your generations.
texts.lev.24.4: Upon the pure candlestick shall he arrange the lamps before Jehovah continually.
texts.lev.24.5: And thou shalt take fine wheaten flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof; each cake shall be of two tenths.
texts.lev.24.6: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six in a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.
texts.lev.24.7: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row; and it shall be a bread of remembrance, an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.lev.24.8: Every sabbath day he shall arrange it before Jehovah continually, on the part of the children of Israel: [it is] an everlasting covenant.
texts.lev.24.9: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy unto him of Jehovah's offerings by fire: [it is] an everlasting statute.
texts.lev.24.10: And the son of an Israelitish woman -- but withal the son of an Egyptian, -- went out among the children of Israel; and this son of the Israelitess and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
texts.lev.24.11: and the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
texts.lev.24.12: And they confined him, that they might decide at the mouth of Jehovah.
texts.lev.24.13: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.lev.24.14: Lead the reviler outside the camp; and all that heard [him] shall lay their hands upon his head, and the whole assembly shall stone him.
texts.lev.24.15: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Every one when he revileth his God shall bear his sin.
texts.lev.24.16: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah shall certainly be put to death; all the assembly shall certainly stone him; as well the stranger as he that is home-born, when he blasphemeth the Name, shall be put to death.
texts.lev.24.17: And if any one smiteth any man mortally, he shall certainly be put to death.
texts.lev.24.18: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.
texts.lev.24.19: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour, as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
texts.lev.24.20: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him.
texts.lev.24.21: He that smiteth a beast [mortally] shall make it good; and he that smiteth a man [mortally] shall be put to death.
texts.lev.24.22: Ye shall have one law: as the stranger, so the home-born; for I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.24.23: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they led the reviler outside the camp and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.lev.25.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
texts.lev.25.2: Speak unto the children of Israel and say unto them, When ye come into the land that I will give you, the land shall celebrate a sabbath to Jehovah.
texts.lev.25.3: Six years shalt thou sow thy field, and six years shalt thou prune thy vineyard, and gather in the produce thereof,
texts.lev.25.4: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest for the land, a sabbath to Jehovah. Thy field shalt thou not sow, and thy vineyard shalt thou not prune.
texts.lev.25.5: That which springeth up from the scattered seed of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thine undressed vines thou shalt not gather: a year of rest shall it be for the land.
texts.lev.25.6: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you, for thee, and for thy bondman, and for thy handmaid, and for thy hired servant, and for him that dwelleth as a sojourner with thee, and for thy cattle,
texts.lev.25.7: and for the beasts that are in thy land: all the produce thereof shall be for food.
texts.lev.25.8: And thou shalt count seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; so that the days of the seven sabbaths of years be unto thee forty-nine years.
texts.lev.25.9: Then shalt thou cause the loud sound of the trumpet to go forth in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the day of atonement shall ye cause the trumpet to go forth throughout your land.
texts.lev.25.10: And ye shall hallow the year of the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty in the land unto all the inhabitants thereof; a [year of] jubilee shall it be unto you, and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family;
texts.lev.25.11: a year of jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap its aftergrowth, nor gather [the fruit of] its undressed vines.
texts.lev.25.12: For it is the jubilee; it shall be holy unto you; out of the field shall ye eat its produce.
texts.lev.25.13: In this year of the jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.
texts.lev.25.14: And if ye sell ought unto your neighbour, or buy of your neighbour's hand, ye shall not overreach one another.
texts.lev.25.15: According to the number of years since the jubilee, thou shalt buy of thy neighbour; according to the number of years of the produce, he shall sell unto thee.
texts.lev.25.16: According to the greater number of the years, thou shalt increase the price thereof; and according to the fewness of years, thou shalt diminish the price of it; for it is the number of crops that he selleth unto thee.
texts.lev.25.17: And ye shall not oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God; for I am Jehovah your God.
texts.lev.25.18: And ye shall do my statutes, and observe mine ordinances and do them: thus shall ye dwell in your land securely.
texts.lev.25.19: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat and be satisfied, and dwell therein securely.
texts.lev.25.20: And if ye say, What shall we eat in the seventh year? behold, we may not sow, nor gather in our produce;
texts.lev.25.21: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, that it may bring forth produce for three years;
texts.lev.25.22: and ye shall sow in the eighth year, and ye shall eat of the old fruit until the ninth year; until her produce come in, ye shall eat the old.
texts.lev.25.23: And the land shall not be sold for ever; for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
texts.lev.25.24: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
texts.lev.25.25: If thy brother grow poor, and sell of his possession, then shall his redeemer, his nearest relation, come and redeem that which his brother sold.
texts.lev.25.26: And if the man have no one having right of redemption, and his hand have acquired and found what sufficeth for its redemption,
texts.lev.25.27: then shall he reckon the years since the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and so return unto his possession.
texts.lev.25.28: And if his hand have not found what sufficeth for him to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of the purchaser, until the year of jubilee; and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
texts.lev.25.29: And if any one sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he shall have the right of redemption up to the end of the year of the sale thereof; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.
texts.lev.25.30: But if it be not redeemed until a whole year is complete, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it, throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.
texts.lev.25.31: But the houses in villages that have no wall round about them shall be reckoned as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
texts.lev.25.32: But as to the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites shall have a perpetual right of redemption.
texts.lev.25.33: And if any one redeem from one of the Levites, then the house that was sold, in the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
texts.lev.25.34: And the field of the suburbs of their cities shall not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
texts.lev.25.35: And if thy brother grow poor, and he be fallen into decay beside thee, then thou shalt relieve him, [be he] stranger or sojourner, that he may live beside thee.
texts.lev.25.36: Thou shalt take no usury nor increase of him; and thou shalt fear thy God; that thy brother may live beside thee.
texts.lev.25.37: Thy money shalt thou not give him upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
texts.lev.25.38: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.
texts.lev.25.39: And if thy brother grow poor beside thee, and be sold unto thee, thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
texts.lev.25.40: as a hired servant, as a sojourner, shall he be with thee; until the year of jubilee shall he serve thee.
texts.lev.25.41: Then shall he depart from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
texts.lev.25.42: For they are my bondmen, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as [men] sell bondmen.
texts.lev.25.43: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; and thou shalt fear thy God.
texts.lev.25.44: And as for thy bondman and thy handmaid whom thou shalt have -- of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and handmaids.
